source: topic:equal game time grassroots football blog
title: Equal Playing Time in Grassroots Football
context: Junior Grassroots Hub article (24 Dec 2024, about 1,400 words) for parents worried their child gets too little game time: what to ask about the coach's philosophy before moving team. Cites the FA's youth guidance; no independent sites.
fit_note: Their piece tells parents to check whether time is shared fairly before moving team but gives no way to work out a fair share; our free calculator shows each child's minutes for their format and squad size
angle: Offer the calculator beside the line where they tell parents to keep a note of their child's minutes and compare them with the other players, in 'Equal playing time on the pitch': it works out what a fair share actually is for the format and squad size. Pitch as two independent grassroots sites for parents whose pieces sit well together. Pitch only the calculator: their article competes with our equal playing time guide.
